pages.text: Spirit Iron unpacks into nine pale-violet nuggets and crafts back. The nuggets are used by the Substitute Puppet and Miniature Immortal Ruin.

pages.title: Immortal Furnace Recipe
pages.text: A Spirit Crystal Block becomes inactive Nurturing Crystal Bedrock only in an Immortal Furnace; furnaces and blast furnaces do not accept it.
Surround inactive bedrock with eight Immortal Power. Active bedrock grows four crystal stages in any dimension. Personal-realm time flow accelerates the dimension ticks that drive growth.

pages.title: Mature Clusters
pages.text: Only the final cluster drops Nurturing Crystal. It requires Netherite mining level, drops one by default and supports Fortune. The bedrock uses the common budding-block tag for compatible growth accelerators.
Nurturing Crystal, a Netherite Block and a Spirit Core craft shapelessly into Premixed Heavy Compound.

pages.title: Heavy Core
pages.text: Premixed Heavy Compound becomes one Heavy Core only in an Immortal Furnace.
